name: git-diff
author: lumine-code
description: Marks lines in the editor gutter that have been added, edited, or deleted since the last commit.

showIconsInEditorGutter.title: Show Icons In Editor Gutter
showIconsInEditorGutter.description: Show colored icons for added (`+`), modified (`·`) and removed (`-`) lines in the editor's gutter, instead of the default line-number and deletion markers.

wrapAroundOnMoveToDiff.title: Wrap Around On Move To Diff
wrapAroundOnMoveToDiff.description: Wraps around to the first/last diff in the file when moving to next/previous diff.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Settings of the git-diff layer drawn on the scrollbar and minimap by the marker hub.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show git diff markers on the scrollbar and minimap.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Hide markers if count exceeds this value. Zero means no limit.
